Sentence (English): When we moved here from another state one of the hardes things to leave was our Bosh Dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Love this new, improved model ] || ---------------- || When we moved here from another state one of the hardes things to leave was our Bosh Dishwasher. In our house in our new state, North Carolina, we put up with the old GE dishwasher and only got around to replacing it during some remodeling of another room. We made the change just because we loved our original Bosch. BTW, we also love our Bosch refrigerator. Lights in a dishwasher! What a concept. After we ordered our new top-of-the-line Bosch dishwasher, I read reviews saying that there is no point spending the extra money for the Benchmark; all that extra cost for a few LED lights and a projection clock on the floor! they said. I have installed numerous dishwashers over the years, but however as I was recovering from a stroke, I had decided to have it installed due to Bestbuy's 'free install' promotion. This proved to be a mistake and as such decided to have it installed myself. It is now installed with my original valve and working great. Simple. I also found after the dishwasher was unpacked that both the install and electrical box kits Bestbuy said I needed to purchase was not the case. Seems Bestbuy service and expertise is not there. Very disappointed and will go elsewhere next time.

Sentence (English): I bought this a little over a month ago after having been without a dishwasher for a couple of months.
Comments (English): [ Spacious and a great design! ] || ---------------- || I bought this a little over a month ago after having been without a dishwasher for a couple of months. I wanted to get the new one in time before my daughter was born. And I could not be happier so far. What an awesome dishwasher. It's about the same size as the GE dishwasher we replaced, but it holds more - which is especially noticeable on the middle rack. I no longer have to put my taller Tervis cups on the bottom rack as the middle rack is plenty tall for almost any cup - except for those large Stanleys. I run it once a day on the Normal cycle, using the Finish Quantum dishwasher pods, and I hope this dishwasher lasts me the next 10 years or more! I highly recommend it. I also have to say that part of the joy of this dishwasher for me was the installation, the removal of the broken dishwasher (I had a GE dishwasher that kept malfunctioning - first the control board, then the motor, after only 5 years! ), and the 4th of July Sale price. I also had the top-rated plumber company in our area out and I asked him if he had any dishwasher recommendations - because it seemed like it was Bosch and then everything else - but the plumber said KitchenAid was the way to go, as he had a Bosch and had nothing but problems with it (which sounds like a rare case, but still - for the price, I'm glad I listened and went with the less expensive option of Kitchen Aid). If you're in the market for a new dishwasher, I highly recommend this KitchenAid!

I ordered it around 0:30 on Sunday, August 11th. Oh my, I got a delivery text message in the afternoon on the 11th, and the installer called me in the evening, and it was installed at 1:00 PM on Monday, the 12th. It took over an hour to install. The washing time is less than an hour. The noise level is greatly reduced. I use it every day. I really like this product at this price. All the appliances in my house are LG products, and the SyncQ function is also very convenient. The detergent is open without a button, so you can just put it in. I haven't used the drying function yet, and judging from the cups that I wipe, there are no water stains. I'm getting my water purifier serviced, and since it was the day they came, I got the salt service and put it in the bottom in a 1:1 ratio with the water from the purifier~~

They know nothing about the functioning or details, tell the consumer incorrect information and essentially do not do any follow up upon purchase. I had to do all the leg work for when both the dishwasher and refrigerator were delivered and track down their installers. I am hoping someone from Kitchen Aid will reach out to me to resolve these issues.

Sentence (English): I heard a lot of people say that LG is the best for dishwashers, so I decided to order one.
Comments (English): [ Make sure to check the model name and features! ] || ---------------- || I heard a lot of people say that LG is the best for dishwashers, so I decided to order one. I just went ahead and ordered it via Coupang with installation. Purchase review: First of all, my family also uses an LG dishwasher. We ordered the latest model at the time when we were getting married, but the exterior design is almost identical to this one. If you search for LG dishwashers, you can see cases where models with similar designs differ in price by over 100,000 to 200,000 won. It's all just a difference in features! This product doesn't have hot air drying, but it does have high-temperature drying. As someone who has used hot air drying, it feels similar. So, you need to shake out the water that has accumulated after the dishwasher finishes. It has all the basic functions as well. It has a sterilization function, so it gives me confidence that it will be cleaner than washing by hand. Especially after eating greasy food, sometimes I feel a bit uneasy even after washing dishes twice. But when I use the dishwasher, everything comes out squeaky clean with no grease smell! I am very satisfied. Also, sometimes when I wash cups incorrectly and they seem to have a fishy water smell, I just hand them all over to the dishwasher lady, and she takes care of it perfectly. I hesitated to order it because I thought I wouldn't use it often, but even if I don't use it frequently, it is very useful for removing grease and fishy water smells like that. It is especially helpful for stains (?) or odors (?) on food containers. I am satisfied after using it just a few times like this. I wish I could win the lottery and have the wealth to give this as a gift to everyone. Even if the exterior design is similar, the functions differ depending on the model name. Sentence (English): I replaced a 20 year old kitchenaid that was 'top of the line' at the time.
Comments (English): [ Very Quiet and Drys Great ] || ---------------- || I replaced a 20 year old kitchenaid that was 'top of the line' at the time. I was worried that they \"don't make them like they used to\" which I have found to be true for many appliances. Not here. This one is unbelievably great. First, the stainless steel finish is immaculate. Not a blemish on it, just an unbelievably classically good looking unit. The knurled handle eliminates finger prints. The unit is OH SO QUIET. I was a bit concerned about that, because Kitchenaid makes some 39db machines. But even at 44db, this machine, is still whisper quiet. Best part is the drying system. The ProDry system uses a heating element AND fan. The fan blows all the hot air around and vents the humidity out the bottom of the door, so the dishes inside get really dry. It also cleans really well. Only downside? In the \"normal\" wash mode and normal ProDry mode from start to finish is over 3 hours of run time. We usually run ours right before bedtime so it doesn't make a difference. Anyway, GREAT MACHINE.

Sentence (English): I replaced a 20 year old kitchenaid that was 'top of the line' at the time.
Comments (English): [ Cleans Great, Drys Even Better! ] || ---------------- || I replaced a 20 year old kitchenaid that was 'top of the line' at the time. I was worried that they "don't make them like they used to" which I have found to be true for many appliances. Not here. This one is unbelievably great. First, the stainless steel finish is immaculate. Not a blemish on it, just an unbelievably classically good looking unit. The knurled handle eliminates finger prints. The unit is OH SO QUIET. I was a bit concerned about that, because Kitchenaid makes some 39db machines. But even at 44db, this machine is still whisper quiet. Best part is the drying system. The ProDry system uses a heating element AND fan. The fan blows all the hot air around and vents the humidity out the bottom of the door, so the dishes inside get really dry. Much better than my older unit that had a bigger heating element. It also cleans really well, and the third rack comes in handy. Only downside? In the "normal" wash mode and normal ProDry mode from start to finish is over 3 hours of run time. We usually run ours right before bedtime so it doesn't make a difference. Anyway, GREAT MACHINE.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher has been running reliably and without problems for two years.
Comments (English): [ reliable and trouble-free for two years ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher has been running reliably and without problems for two years. The optional control via the Bosch HomeConnect app is nice. This means that if the machine is already filled with tabs, you can simply start the program from anywhere at any time when it suits you - or you can plan the start time. Great, for example, if you use a balcony power station to get everything ready at 6:00 a.m. and then just press the virtual button from work when it's particularly sunny at 11:00 a.m. The additional washing programs available in the app are also good. Overall, very satisfied.
Comments (Original): [ seit zwei Jahren zuverlässig und ohne Störung ] || ---------------- || Der Geschirrspüler läuft seit zwei Jahren zuverlässig und ohne Störungen.Schön ist die optionale Steuerung über die Bosch HomeConnect App. So kann man, wenn die Maschine bereits mit Tab befüllt ist, einfach irgendwann, wenn es passt, von überall aus das Programm starten  - oder aber den Starttermin planen.Toll z.B. bei Nutzung eines Balkonkraftwerkes morgens um 6:00 Uhr alles fertig machen und dann von der Arbeit aus, wenn es um 11:00 Uhr besonders sonnig ist, einfach das virtuelle Knöpfchen drücken.Auch die in der App zusätzlich verfügbaren Spülprogramme sind gut.Insgesamt sehr zufrieden.

Sentence (English): Our Kitchen Aid dishwasher was delivered and installed by Costco on 5/21/24, so we have had it almost 3 months.
Comments (English): [ Clean dishes and quiet operation ] || ---------------- || Our Kitchen Aid dishwasher was delivered and installed by Costco on 5/21/24, so we have had it almost 3 months. The entire delivery, install and haul away was excellent. We originally intended to purchase the dishwasher with the towel handle bar on the front, but were advised by our son that the bar can come down and painfully hit your foot. After seeing how low the door is to the floor when open, much lower than the old dishwasher, we are very glad we did not get the towel bar handle.Overall, we are very pleased with this dishwasher, especially how clean it gets the dishes and how very quiet it runs. We only have two major complaints. First are the longer cycle times, which it seems like all dishwashers now have. (Without drying, Express takes 1 hour and 11 minutes, Normal takes about 2 hours and 35 minutes). We open the door when finished and the dishes are dry in the morning. The other issue is that this dishwasher only came with 2 wine glass clips, so we had to purchase 4 more, and that's why I removed one star in the rating. At this price point, I don't know why they couldn't include 6 clips. The dishwasher is giant, and will hold dishes from a dinner party of 6, except only came with 2 wine glass holders. Who has a dinner party and only uses 2 wine glasses? The clips work well and fold down out of the way if you don't need them.What we love about the dishwasher is its performance! Dishes are sparkling clean! And the size is amazing with the top 3rd shelf that actually holds glasses, mugs and not just silverware. When it's just the two of us, it can take several days before we need to run it. Also, it runs so quietly, we can run it while watching TV.Highly recommended.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher is so quiet, that when away from it, the only indication it's on is when it drains.
Comments (English): [ Super Quiet, Cleans well, some flexibility issues ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher is so quiet, that when away from it, the only indication it's on is when it drains. Pluses: - Quietness - Loading flexibility is almost perfect, have some tall items that barely fit when the upper rack is at its lowest setting. - With the upper rack at its lowest setting, the wash arm still clears the largest dinner plates. - Bought the Cutlery Basket SMZ4000UC, and use the third rack for knives and utensils. - The heavy cycle can remove food starch from pots that previously required scouring powder and 'elbow grease'. Flaws: - This is my first condensation drying dishwasher, the only flaw so far has been that the door won't hold itself open until it is at a 45 degree angle (confirmed with support that it is a design 'feature'). This means that the interior is prone to sweating if the door is sealed between wash cycles.

Comments (English): Even though we are a family of two, dishes pile up the moment you turn your back. Sentence (English): Disappointing dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Does Not Dry ] || ---------------- || Disappointing dishwasher. I purchased this unit to replace an old GE dishwasher in my summer kitchen, so I didn't think I needed an expensive model. This dishwasher dries with steam only. And worse - it does not vent the steam when the cycle is done. I called a GE repair man because even with a 3.5 hour cycle, the dishes are barely dry and water droplets remain all over the plastic interior. Not good if you leave the dishes for more than a day. The repair man said it was functioning properly, with 160 degree rinse cycle to generate steam. He recommended using the sanitize cycle, which is over 4 hours! I do not recommend this dishwasher. I would not have purchased it if I knew about the Dry Boost configuration.

Sentence (English): I purchased this dishwasher in May 2023 and it never really worked correctly.
Comments (English): [ Purchase with Caution ] || ---------------- || I purchased this dishwasher in May 2023 and it never really worked correctly. Constantly setting off the leak detection which would shut down the ability to use it. After several service calls and 14 months of battling with LG it was finally determined that the unit was damaged during manufacturing and would never work correctly, it would always leak. This was a problem that should have been easily noticed on the first service call. Once it was determined that it was damaged we waited an additional 2 months, many phone calls, and yet another service call appt to verify what they already knew, before the replacement unit was finally delivered. LG's Customer Service was so bad I honestly will never buy another LG product based on that alone . All that aside though, now that I have a working unit my opinion is this. I dislike the fact that it does not dry the dishes. I am told they don't make units that do this anymore. But as far as washing it seems to do a good enough job. I want to find at least one positive thing to say about it. The third row is awesome, its a tiny tray at the top that holds silverware, lids, etc. Love that feature. I think if you purchased this unit and got lucky enough to never need service you'd probably be ok with it as long as you don't like heat dry. But if you are ok with air dry and you if you got a unit that wasn't damaged & in need of service, you would probably like this unit just fine.

Sentence (English): When I purchased a stainless steel dishwasher, I expected to be able to use stainless steel cleaner on it to remove fingerprints.
Comments (English): [ Wish I hadn't bought this ] || ---------------- || When I purchased a stainless steel dishwasher, I expected to be able to use stainless steel cleaner on it to remove fingerprints. The front of the unit is flimsy - not a hard solid surface like most dishwashers. I had no idea until I sprayed it with the stainless steel cleaner I use on all of my appliances. When I tried to wipe it off, the front cover was flimsy and moved in and out as I tried to wipe it down. The cleaner smeared everywhere. I had a hard time getting it clean. When I buy a stainless steel appliance, especially at this price, I expect higher quality. Additionally, I saw that the specs listed it had a water softener. Sentence (English): Enjoying our Bosch 500 series dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Nice ] || ---------------- || Enjoying our Bosch 500 series dishwasher. Cleans dishes well With the recommended pods. I like the third rack and use it for the silverware instead of basket on bottom rack, so that creates more space for plates/bowls. Don't love the way the prongs are set on the bottom and even the middle racks as it limits the way some glasses and dishes can be put in, but overall it works. Third rack does limit taller cups and dishes I used to be able to get in my former two rack dishwasher--but i just wash those by hand now--no biggie. I use the speed 60 cycle and open it to ensure drying. I don't like to use the heated dry as it just takes too long and wastes energy. I was looking forward to using the pop open feature, but it only works through the app and with the regular 2 hr cycle. The app is pretty stinky overall, so stopped using it and just use the control panel. I do like that it comes up on my Apple Watch when the cycle is completed. It was expensive, but overall I do think it's been worth it.

Sentence (English): I used to dread having to run the dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ I legit look forward to running my dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I used to dread having to run the dishwasher. Honestly I've hand washed most items in my life unless I'm hosting because previous dishwashers were unreliable. I either needed to pre-rinse and clean so much that I might as well finish the job by hand myself, or be left with stuck on food on plates/utentsils, and I always had to inspect my "cleaned" dishes thoroughly afterwards as well or suffer the embarrassment of a missed food spot when hosting family and friends. Before we get into the amazing cleaning potential of Bosch, I want to say how amazing the three rack system is. The design of the racks makes it easy to load various types of dishes, cookware, and utensils without having to play Tetris. It was always a literal balancing act of laying certain dishes on whatever side. Now I can just put dishes in and they just fit. Now to the cleaning, I never realized how clean a dishwasher could be. Honestly there's no residue or anything. And cleaning the filter is such a breeze! Yes, plastics still tend to be a little wet but I've never encountered a dishwasher that could dry plastics without melting them. But it's amazing how even the all the small nooks get cleaned so this is already a huge improvement. Best of all, NO PRE-RINSING! This is such a game changer where I can just focus on hosting and eating, instead of cleaning the whole time. Thank you Bosch for making my life way easier and allowing me to spend time on the things that matter. I'm a big fan and I wished I bought a Bosch sooner. All my friends have switched and they've experienced this greatness as well. You've made BIFL customers!

Sentence (English): We've had our dishwasher about a month now and are still getting used to it.
Comments (English): [ Can't Get Rid Of Smell ] || ---------------- || We've had our dishwasher about a month now and are still getting used to it. It is just my husband and myself so we only run the dishwasher about every 3 to 4 days. We noticed that in between washings our dishwasher gets very smelly inside, almost like garbage. We rinse our dishes very well before putting them in the dishwasher. We never had this problem with our old dishwasher. The smell is only with our new Bosch. We were hoping the smell would go away after we used it awhile, but it's been almost a month, and it's still there. There is no rinse-only cycle so there appears is nothing we can do in-between loads. We like how quiet our Bosch is, but like many other reviewers have commented, the silverware holder is very small, even for the two of us. I wash out silverware between loads. This is our first Bosch dishwasher and although we like it, at this point, I'm not sure I would buy this top of the line model again; and I certainly would look for a dishwasher that has a rinse-only cycle. Hopefully the smell of garbage goes away in time.

Sentence (English): I bought this Bosch 800 series dishwasher about a month ago.
Comments (English): [ So far so good. ] || ---------------- || I bought this Bosch 800 series dishwasher about a month ago. I got it in black stainless steel (which in actuality is more like dark gray). The dishwasher it replaced was a different manufacturer and I was never really happy with its performance. I read a lot of reviews and everyone one the internet claim that this Bosch is thee dishwasher to have. Since the interior liner of the dishwasher is stainless the dishwasher feels substantial. My old dishwasher was plastic inside. Not only does this metal interior make it feel sturdier but It makes it much quieter while running as well. There are three levels of racks in the dishwasher. The main rack, the cup rack, and above that, there's a third rack used for silverware and other small items. There's also a small basket on the main rack for larger utensils. I'm not used to having a third rack for utensils but after a month of use all the utensils/ silverware seem to be very clean. Also, I haven't used any type of rinse agent and the cups are looking very clean and not spotty at all. The dishwasher is a under counter design. It features solid-state finger sensor button technology. Not traditional functioning buttons. So when you touch the power. It creates a musical tone that sounds upward in the scale. When you touch the power button a second time, the tones go down the scale signaling power off. It's definitely fancier than my last dishwasher. Use pick all your wash settings while the washer door is ajar. Once you close the door the display screen turns off. It will no longer display information during the wash, instead a small light is shined down onto the floor from the bottom of the dishwasher. When the light turns off - as the say in the movies, "the dishes are done man! " You can also download an app to show you current wash time and other dishwasher information and totally connect it to the internet and nerd out but none of that is necessary. You can use the dishwasher just fine with all the extra techie stuff. It's a pretty nice dishwasher but heck, it should be. It certainly wasn't cheap!

Sentence (English): At first this dishwasher seemed like a dream.
Comments (English): [ Not So Smart, Kinda Janky ] || ---------------- || At first this dishwasher seemed like a dream. It really is whisper quiet! Like so quiet you can't hear it running at all. The first issue encountered was that it wouldn't connect to the app, no matter what we did. This was consistent with our experience with our Samsung range, and we decided it didn't need to be that kind of smart. The next problem was that the wire rack started losing pieces, as in they would bend a little bit and when you tried to gently bend it back it would just snap right off. Again, it was so quiet that we decided to keep going. Then things just started slowly getting off kilter. The upper rack wouldn't stay in place. The dishes stopped getting clean no matter how many times we cleaned out the food traps and we even started scrubbing the dishes before they went in. Then shortly after the warranty period ended, we bumped an interior side part with a pan and it broke off. Pulled the dishwasher out, reattached the part, and the little ips that held the dishwasher to the counter snapped in two--both of them-- when trying to reattach. No worries, ordered two new clips. But the replacement clips weren't the same design as the old clips despite putting in the model number. It's fine, I managed to rig it in place. Now after a year and a half, despite being a household of two and only using the dishwasher once or twice a week, the control panel has gone dead. Like dead dead. Confirmed there is power to the dishwasher on the house side of things, and removed the front of the machine to see if there were any obvious wiring or control panel issues. Nothing. I have to assume it is smart enough to die after the warranty. Then putting the front panel back on, two of the heads from the screws it was screwed on with just snapped off. Snapped right off with just screwdriver tightening. This was easily one of the worst appliance purchases ever.

Comments (English): [ Dishwasher owned for 2 years, multiple issues ] || ---------------- || I bought this dishwasher a little over two years ago. I have quite a few issues with this dishwasher. The middle rack feels very weak and I can see a visible bending happen when I load coffee mugs on that shelf. The dishwasher last night started to beep and the lcd screen started to have issues where I could not see any numbers for a few minutes. Then after 5 minutes all of the buttons started to cycle through the settings. I turned off the dishwasher overnight at the breaker. the next morning it looked fine. but after trying to run a load the dishwasher is displaying a F6E1 error cord. I have had the F6E1 error code show up three other times in the past two years, but this time I cannot seem to bypass the error at all. The one year warranty for most of the parts seems way to low for an orginal MSRP of $900 Dishwasher. The fact that a lot the customer support in these reviews is directed towards facebook/instagram is worry some.

Comments (English): [ Disappointed ] || ---------------- || I owned a Bosch for over 15 years and loved it, so when I had to replace it, I really wanted a Bosch and purchased one from Home Depot. I have had it since April and there is a smell of burned rubber or something. Two technichians have come and one took it completly out to rule our anything electrical. This did not fix it and the smell is still there. I was told I should add a freshner but I do not see why I should be buying additional items to try to resolve this. I will try to do so when I can find this special freshner at a store but I am not very optimistic. I appreciated the two techs trying to fix it but I think it is a flaw in the dishwasher. I must say that it does a good job and my dishes are clean, it is just the smell that bothers me. I have delayed sending a review in the hopes that the issues I am having would be resolved but sadly enouth it has not. I do not like giving bad reviews but I did pay a good amount of money for a higher end washer and I am disappointed. I wish they would replace it but I was told only the Tech would make that decision and neither one mentioned they would ask for a replacement since they had a hard time smelling it. It is sad to think that I will have to live with this smell for many years since I cannot replace it. Also, I read your Terms and Conditions and they are intimidating to someone like myself who is retired.

Sentence (English): Bought this dishwasher a month ago to replace a 20+ year old Whirlpool Gold dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Whirlpool Model #WDF341PAPW ] || ---------------- || Bought this dishwasher a month ago to replace a 20+ year old Whirlpool Gold dishwasher. The new dishwasher is much quieter than the old unit and does a similar job cleaning the dishes. The new unit takes an hour on the quick wash cycle versus 45 minutes with the older unit. If you turn on the heat dry option, it adds an extra 54 minutes to any cycle. The new unit has less interior room and holds less dishes. I also purchased the 5 year extended warranty through Lowes and have discovered this warranty does nothing the 1st year of ownership because this is the time period for the limited manufacturer warranty. The problem with the limited manufacturer warranty is it only covers parts and labor. It does "not" cover the $150 service call. After purchasing this unit, I have read many complaints online that the sump pump is prone to failure within the 1st year of operation due to a design defect in the grommet diverter seal. Wen this grommet diverter seal fails, the dishwasher leaks water on the floor and usually shorts out the electric water pump requiring a new sump pump to repair. Average cost for this repair is $450. I am keeping my fingers crossed my new dishwasher makes it at least a year so the Lowes extended warranty will kick in and fully cover any necessary repairs. Whirlpool is aware of this defect and did not change the sump pump design which resulted in a class action lawsuit. I've attached a video illustrating the defective design and repair.

Sentence (English): Over 35 years of homeownership, this is the worst dishwasher in my experience.
Comments (English): [ Very loud and poor cleaning quality ] || ---------------- || Over 35 years of homeownership, this is the worst dishwasher in my experience. After a little over a year, I've decided to throw it away and upgrade. The dishwasher will only clean properly if you use sanitation mode, and even then I have to pre-soak the dishes in hot water and soap to make sure that they are very clean. Further, the dishwasher is running at 65 dB, which is too loud for day use. If I use storm wash mode, the noise is unbearable. The tube that runs at the back of the dishwasher up the wall has already come loose and needed to be re-installed. I have run the cleaning mode every three months with the store cleaner in an attempt to prolong the quality, but this has not helped at all. I think it is interesting that in a little over a year, the price of the dishwasher dropped from around $800 to its current price. Finally, there has been a small worsening of the performance since the dishwasher was brand new, but even in the early days this was a mediocre dishwasher. The D.B. listed in the specs are not relevant because you must run the dishwasher with sanitation and preferably storm wash in order to have clean dishes. Consequence, this is the loudest dishwasher I've ever owned.

It excels in the two areas that are most important to me: it is extremely quiet and it cleans the dishes well. I have a couple of minor complaints, but neither of them affects the effectiveness of the dishwasher. The first is that the third (top) rack is not particularly useful. True, I can get a few short cups or bows on that rack, but the flatware spaces are too few to be useful, yet they take up half of the top rack. The second is that the case of the dishwasher is not fully rectangular. There is a slight rise at the back of the dishwasher (possibly to accommodate the top rack? ). As a result, the installer was not able to raise the level of the dishwasher to be flush with the top and bottom of my cabinets. Sentence (English): You can't complain about how well this machine does its job.
Comments (English): [ Excellent performance, clumsy racks ] || ---------------- || You can't complain about how well this machine does its job. It's outstanding in every aspect of the washing process: cleanliness of dishes, drying, cycle selection, versatility, worthwhile if sometimes unusual features. But Bosch should consider redesigning its racks. They could start with the silverware container. It not only takes up too much space, it gets in way of stacking dishes in fully a quarter of the rack. To top it off, the slots in the silver holder are too small for their job. I've taken it out and am putting my flatware in the machine's top tray. Alas, the short tines there make it hard to put the silver in wash position. With the silver basket out of the way, the bottom rack is fine, but the arrangement of the middle rack is barely OK for glasses and cups, and clumsy for saucers. Buyers should also note that there's no way to tell if the machine has been opened but not unloaded after a wash. Buy yourselves one of those "Clean/Dirty" indicators. One more note: the phone app is better than most, though I don't think many people will use it. It took me a while to install -- shutting down the app and the machine and restarting both of them finally did the trick. So overall, a great dishwasher with a couple of irritating shortcomings. I'm sure I'll get used to the racks and trays, but the flatware situation is a downer.

Nothing out of the ordinary, and everything needful was included. Pros:. * * * * * middle rack can be adjusted up or down - I really love this feature. If you have really tall items in the bottom rack, you can adjust the middle rack upward by pressing a couple of buttons on the side. I scrub my stainless pots with Barkeeps Friend to remove scratches and heavy grime, rinse them well (rinse off the scouring powder), and then put them in the dishwasher and they come out beautiful. usually (see cons). * the third rack is useful for the occasional very long utensil or for the rubber seal of a pitcher or waterproof food container. Cons:. - - - - - doesn't do well with tall, narrow-mouthed objects, such as tumblers and pitchers. The washing action just doesn't "reach" the bottom of the tall pitcher, and the tall tumblers are left with a white "film" at the bottom of the tumbler. (see pic). - - - sometimes leaves a white film on the inside (down side) of my stainless pots and bowls; I haven't figured out yet why it only sometimes does so. - rarely a piece of silverware needs to be rewashed. - very large silverware rack - larger than needed, to be honest, I'd rather have the room for dishes. A split silverware rack - where you could leave half of the rack out when not in use - would be nice.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher was installed in early July.
Comments (English): [ Disappointed ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher was installed in early July. The second time I ran it, it started beeping and all the control panel lights started flashing halfway through the cycle. I called Bosch customer support and the call wait time was exceedingly long. When I was able to speak with a rep, he said it was an "error in the unit." I was instructed to turn off the curcuit breaker, wait 5 minutes, turn the breaker back on, and see if the dishwasher reset. He told me that he could not stay on the line for the 5 minute wait. I was disappointed to hear that. I tried this several times and the unit still kept beeping with the lights still flashing. I called the appliance store where I purchased the dishwasher the next day, which has their own service people, and they came out to assess the problem. The unit was diagnosed with a "faulty multiboard." For a manufacturer that claims it checks all of its products before shipment, this was a very disappointing experience. The new board has been installed and so far the dishwasher appears to be working properly. But my confidence in this product has not been fully restored.
